name: When is kitchen trim necessary rather than just decorative?

mainEntity.name: When is kitchen trim necessary rather than just decorative?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need kitchen trim if there are visible gaps between your cabinets and uneven drywall, unfinished cabinet tops, or exposed under-cabinet wiring. Trim is also essential when switching flooring materials or when cabinet boxes sit unevenly against existing framing. Beyond aesthetic polish, functional trim protects your kitchen: toe-kicks keep debris from collecting underneath lower cabinets, while light rail moldings shield your eyes from the glare of LED task fixtures mounted underneath upper cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim is necessary to hide drywall irregularities, conceal under-cabinet lighting wires, and seal gaps under lower cabinets to prevent dust accumulation.
